title: Position of the Pair Separator
statement: For any Boolean words $\alpha$ and $x$, the encoding formed by doubling each bit of $\alpha$, appending $01$, and then appending $x$ has $0$ at zero-based position $2|\alpha|$ and $1$ at position $2|\alpha|+1$.
replaced:
Cells $2|\alpha|$ and $2|\alpha| + 1$ of the pair encoding
$\langle \alpha, x\rangle$ hold $0$ and $1$ respectively.
